{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
completed_clean['revenue_clean'] = completed_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check: how many QA test orders were in the full data?
qa_test_full = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Total QA test orders in full data: {len(qa_test_full)}")

# Confirm no QA test orders remain in completed_clean
print(f"QA test orders in completed_clean: {len(completed_clean[completed_clean['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Compute average revenue per segment and channel
segment_means = completed_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute difference per segment
segment_diff = segment_means['email'] - segment_means['paid_search']

# Compute weights: segment proportions in email group
email_segment_counts = completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].value_counts()
email_total = email_segment_counts.sum()
email_weights = email_segment_counts / email_total

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (segment_diff * email_weights).sum()

# Store results for evidence
results = {
    'weighted_diff': weighted_diff,
    'unadjusted_diff': completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean() 
                       - completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean(),
    'email_total_revenue': completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].sum(),
    'paid_search_total_revenue': completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].sum(),
    'segment_means': segment_means,
    'segment_diff': segment_diff,
    'email_weights': email_weights,
    'email_segment_counts': email_segment_counts,
    'paid_search_segment_counts': completed_clean[completed_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['customer_segment'].value_counts()
}

# Print all key values
print(f"Weighted average difference (email - paid_search): {results['weighted_diff']:.2f} USD")
print(f"Unadjusted difference (email - paid_search): {results['unadjusted_diff']:.2f} USD")
print(f"Total revenue (email): {results['email_total_revenue']:.2f} USD")
print(f"Total revenue (paid_search): {results['paid_search_total_revenue']:.2f} USD")
print(f"Email segment counts: {results['email_segment_counts'].to_dict()}")
print(f"Paid_search segment counts: {results['paid_search_segment_counts'].to_dict()}")
print(f"Email segment weights: {results['email_weights'].round(3).to_dict()}")
print(f"Segment differences (email - paid_search): {results['segment_diff'].round(2).to_dict()}")"}
